text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 carries a tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that receives I.Z.B.P. plating, but the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 tolerance applies before or after plating. Without this allowance the plated feature may fall out of tolerance and fail to assemble; the designer should add a note specifying if the dimension is pre- or post-plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note clarifying that the 20±0.02 dimension is measured after plating, or adjust the nominal/tolerance to account for the expected plating thickness."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be performed (e.g., before final machining or before surface treatment). The sequence matters because machining a hardened part requires different tooling and leaving it unspecified risks dimensional errors or process conflicts; the designer should add the required stage.","recommended_correction":"Revise note N1 to specify when the toughening to 24-32 HRC shall be done relative to machining and surface treatment."}]}
